facts.text: All Marquette undergraduate students complete the three-tier Marquette Core Curriculum, which is grounded in the Jesuit tradition and structured into Foundations, Discovery, and Culminating courses.

sources.title: Marquette Core Curriculum | Marquette University - Marquette bulletin
sources.quote: The Marquette Core Curriculum (MCC) is the center of every Marquette University undergraduate student's educational experience, providing a distinctive approach that is: Grounded in the Jesuit Tradition.

sources.title: Marquette Core Curriculum | Marquette University - Marquette bulletin
sources.quote: The Marquette Core Curriculum includes three tiers: Foundations, Discovery and Culminating.
